Every state has its own FWC. These are the official state agencies for this region — registration, boating laws, fishing licenses and state-run launch lists, straight from the source. The state sites carry the official rules.

Maine Dept. of Inland Fisheries & Wildlife

Maine's FWC — fishing, boat registration and boating laws in one department. Public launches are run by the Bureau of Parks & Lands.

Register a boat
Boating: registration & laws — MDIFWHow to register, fees, and Maine's boating laws and boater education.
Public launches
State public boat launch list — Bureau of Parks & LandsThe state's own ramp list — the same list this region's ramps were built from.
Fishing
Licenses & rules — MDIFWFishing licenses and rules live with the same department.
NH Fish & Game Dept. + NH Marine Patrol

New Hampshire splits the job: Fish & Game runs fishing and the state's public boat access sites; the Marine Patrol (State Police) runs boating laws and safety certificates. Boat registration is issued by the Dept. of Safety / DMV.

Boating & access
Boating and Access — NH Fish & GameThe Statewide Public Boat Access Program — 140+ state access sites.
Laws & safety
Marine Patrol — NH State PoliceBoating laws, enforcement, and the safety certificate required to run a motorboat over 25 hp.
Fishing
Licenses & rules — NH Fish & GameFishing licenses and rules live with Fish & Game.
Vermont Fish & Wildlife Dept.

Vermont's FWC — it also maintains 180+ developed fishing access areas across the state. Boat registration paperwork runs through the Vermont DMV.

Boating
Boating in Vermont — VT Fish & WildlifeSafety course (required if you were born after Jan. 1, 1974), registration info, and the boating handbook.
Public access
Fishing access areas — VT Fish & WildlifeThe state's own access-area program — ramps and shore fishing statewide.
MA Environmental Police + MassWildlife

Massachusetts splits it too: the Environmental Police handle boat registration, titling and boating-law enforcement; MassWildlife handles fishing.

Register a boat
Boat Registration — MA Environmental PoliceRegistration, titling and renewals. Note: a boater safety-certificate rule for all motorboat operators takes effect April 1, 2026.
Fishing
MassWildlifeFishing licenses, rules, and the state's wildlife lands and access points.
Connecticut DEEP

Connecticut's FWC is the Dept. of Energy & Environmental Protection — its Boating Division runs laws, safety and state launches; vessels themselves register with the DMV.

Boating
Boating and Paddling — CT DEEPBoating laws, state boat launches, and the annual Connecticut Boater's Guide.
Register a boat
Boat Registration — CT DEEPWhat has to be registered and how the DMV registration works.
Fishing
Fisheries Licenses and Permits — CT DEEPFishing licenses and permits from DEEP's Fisheries Division.
Rhode Island DEM

Rhode Island's FWC is the Dept. of Environmental Management — it runs boat registration itself, plus Fish & Wildlife and Marine Fisheries.

Register a boat
Boat Registration — RI DEMDEM's Office of Boat Registration & Licensing; renewals run online through Rhode Island Outdoors.
Fishing
Licenses — RI DEM (Rhode Island Outdoors)Freshwater and saltwater fishing licenses and rules.

🇺🇸 Boaters Nation — Everything boating in America, free for boaters.
